exercises.title: Hedging
exercises.explanation: Слова arguably, tends to и appears to помогают делать точные, осторожные утверждения вместо абсолютных.

exercises.prompt: The evidence appears to suggest that…
exercises.translation: По всей видимости, данные указывают на то, что…
exercises.example: The evidence appears to suggest that the change improved retention.

exercises.prompt: Можно утверждать, что этот подход более устойчив.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: It could be argued that this approach is more sustainable.
acceptedAnswers: Arguably, this approach is more sustainable.

exercises.prompt: Результаты, по всей видимости, подтверждают гипотезу.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The findings appear to support the hypothesis.

exercises.prompt: The policy ___ benefit smaller teams, although more evidence is needed.
To a certain extent…
exercises.example: To a certain extent, both interpretations are valid.

exercises.prompt: В определённой степени это зависит от контекста.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: To a certain extent, it depends on the context.
acceptedAnswers: It depends on the context to a certain extent.

exercises.prompt: Это не обязательно означает, что стратегия провалилась.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: This does not necessarily mean that the strategy failed.

exercises.prompt: The decline is ___ linked to seasonal demand.
Хотя вывод правдоподобен, данные нельзя считать окончательными.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: While the conclusion is plausible, the evidence cannot be considered conclusive.
acceptedAnswers: Although the conclusion is plausible, the evidence cannot be regarded as conclusive.

chapters.title: Emphasis and Inversion
chapters.subtitle: Инверсия, клефт-конструкции и способы усиления в предложении

lessons.title: Inversion After Negatives
lessons.summary: Инверсия после отрицательных и ограничительных наречий в начале предложения.

exercises.title: Инверсия после отрицательных наречий
exercises.explanation: Когда предложение начинается с отрицательного или ограничительного наречия (never, rarely, seldom, not only, no sooner), подлежащее и вспомогательный глагол меняются местами — как в вопросе: Never have I seen it.

exercises.prompt: Never have I seen
exercises.example: Never have I seen anything like it.

exercises.prompt: Not only... but also...
exercises.example: Not only did she apologize, but she also paid for the damage.

exercises.prompt: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explanation: После Never в начале предложения нужна инверсия: вспомогательный глагол перед подлежащим.

exercises.prompt: Я никогда не видел такого красивого заката.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
acceptedAnswers: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset.
I've never seen such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.hint: Начни с Never и используй инверсию.

exercises.prompt: Никогда я не видел такого хаоса.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Never have I seen such chaos.

exercises.prompt: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
exercises.explanation: После Not only в начале предложения используется инверсия: was he.

exercises.prompt: Она не только опоздала, но и забыла билеты.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Not only was she late, but she also forgot the tickets.
acceptedAnswers: Not only was she late but she also forgot the tickets.
exercises.hint: Начни с Not only и сделай инверсию.

exercises.prompt: Seldom ___ a politician admit a mistake so openly.
exercises.explanation: Инверсия после Seldom требует вспомогательного does для единственного числа.

exercises.title: No sooner... than
exercises.explanation: Конструкции No sooner... than и Hardly... when тоже требуют инверсии: No sooner had I arrived than it started to rain.

lessons.title: Cleft Sentences
lessons.summary: Клефт-конструкции It was X that... и What I need is... для выделения смысла.

exercises.title: Клефт-конструкции
exercises.explanation: Клефт-конструкции выделяют важную часть фразы. It was... that/who... подчёркивает подлежащее или дополнение, а What... is... выделяет то, что действительно важно.

exercises.prompt: What I need is...
exercises.example: What I need is a good night's sleep.

exercises.prompt: ___ John who broke the window, not Peter.
exercises.explanation: Клефт-конструкция для выделения подлежащего начинается с It was.

exercises.prompt: Именно Мария разбила вазу, а не я.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: It was Maria who broke the vase, not me.
acceptedAnswers: It was Maria that broke the vase, not me.

exercises.prompt: Что мне нужно, так это больше времени.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: What I need is more time.

exercises.prompt: Что мне действительно нужно, так это отпуск.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: What I really need is a holiday.
acceptedAnswers: What I really need is a vacation.
exercises.hint: Начни с What I really need is...

exercises.prompt: What ___ is a clear explanation.
exercises.explanation: В клефте с What используется обычный порядок слов: What I want is...

exercises.prompt: It was then that...
exercises.example: It was then that I realized my mistake.

exercises.prompt: Именно вчера я встретил её.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: It was yesterday that I met her.
acceptedAnswers: It was yesterday when I met her.

exercises.prompt: Именно здесь мы познакомились.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: It was here that we met.

chapters.title: The Nuanced Argument
chapters.subtitle: Уступка и контраст: despite, whereas, nonetheless и продвинутые связки в формальном и идиоматичном регистре.

lessons.title: Concession and Contrast
lessons.summary: Учимся уступать и противопоставлять с помощью despite, whereas и nonetheless.

exercises.title: Despite vs Although
exercises.explanation: После despite и in spite of идёт существительное или герундий (despite the delay, despite being tired), а после although — целое придаточное предложение с подлежащим и глаголом.

exercises.prompt: despite
exercises.example: Despite the setbacks, the team delivered the project on time.

exercises.prompt: whereas
exercises.translation: тогда как, в то время как (контраст)
exercises.example: He favours a cautious approach, whereas his partner prefers to take bold risks.

exercises.prompt: nonetheless
exercises.example: The evidence was circumstantial; nonetheless, the jury was convinced.

exercises.prompt: ___ his considerable talent, he never achieved the recognition he deserved.
exercises.explanation: Перед существительным (talent) нужно despite, а не although (перед предложением) или however.

exercises.prompt: Northern buyers tend to negotiate slowly, ___ southern clients close deals within days.
Несмотря на плотный график, она нашла время прочитать весь отчёт.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Despite her busy schedule, she found time to read the entire report.
acceptedAnswers: In spite of her busy schedule, she found time to read the entire report.
Despite her tight schedule, she found time to read the whole report.

exercises.prompt: Продукт получил тёплые отзывы; тем не менее продажи остались вялыми.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The product received warm reviews; nonetheless, sales remained sluggish.
acceptedAnswers: The product received warm reviews; nevertheless, sales remained sluggish.
The product got warm reviews; nonetheless, sales stayed sluggish.

exercises.prompt: В то время как теория элегантна, данные противоречат ей.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Whereas the theory is elegant, the data contradicts it.

exercises.prompt: Хотя план выглядел рискованным, совет директоров единогласно его одобрил.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Although the plan looked risky, the board approved it unanimously.
acceptedAnswers: Though the plan looked risky, the board approved it unanimously.
Even though the plan looked risky, the board unanimously approved it.

lessons.title: Advanced Connectors and Register
lessons.summary: Продвинутые связки и переход между формальным и идиоматичным регистром.

exercises.title: Register matters
exercises.explanation: Notwithstanding и albeit звучат формально и уместны в письменной аргументации, тогда как идиомы вроде that said или having said that смягчают контраст в разговорной речи.

exercises.prompt: albeit
exercises.example: The reform was a success, albeit a costly one.

exercises.prompt: that said
exercises.translation: тем не менее; при этом (смягчает предыдущее утверждение)
exercises.example: The film is far too long. That said, the performances are outstanding.

exercises.prompt: The measures were unpopular; ___ the strong opposition, the government pushed them through.
exercises.explanation: Notwithstanding + существительное означает 'несмотря на' в формальном регистре.

exercises.prompt: Her argument was compelling, ___ somewhat one-sided.
exercises.explanation: Albeit вводит краткую уступку перед прилагательным или фразой.

exercises.prompt: Отчёт тщательный, пусть и немного затянутый.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The report is thorough, albeit somewhat long-winded.
acceptedAnswers: The report is thorough, albeit a little long-winded.
The report is thorough, though somewhat long-winded.

exercises.prompt: Идея дорогая. При этом отдача может оправдать вложения.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The idea is expensive. That said, the returns may justify the investment.
acceptedAnswers: The idea is expensive. Having said that, the returns may justify the investment.
The idea is costly. That said, the returns might justify the investment.

exercises.prompt: Несмотря на возражения, комитет утвердил бюджет.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Notwithstanding the objections, the committee approved the budget.

exercises.prompt: Он согласился помочь, хотя и с явной неохотой.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: He agreed to help, albeit with obvious reluctance.
acceptedAnswers: He agreed to help, though with obvious reluctance.
He agreed to help, albeit with evident reluctance.

exercises.prompt: Choose the most formal way to open a written concession: '___ the criticism, the policy has clear merits.'
exercises.explanation: Notwithstanding — самый формальный вариант; that said и anyway разговорнее.
